No retry, ambiguous success, ordinary-practice admission or product record was released.
All owned Docker resources and the ephemeral attachment are absent after cleanup.
The native Harness worker failed before DeepSeek was called and therefore supplies no evidence about DeepSeek reasoning or coding quality.
The stopped-server coordinate is narrower than attempt 004's combined liveness-or-identity coordinate, but the retained evidence cannot select the underlying exit cause.
Five workflow incidents are contained; their prevention direction is generated schema-backed readings rather than additional memory rules.

No further disposable PostgreSQL execution is authorised; any attempt 006 requires a separately frozen plan and one-run checkpoint.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every Git source entering a worker controller must be injected from the machine resolver as the exact current 40-character commit and must never be transcribed or completed by the orchestrator.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first controller draft contained a 40-character-looking Git identifier that did not equal the machine-resolved current HEAD.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Controller prepare resolved and compared the source before worker dispatch, rejected the mismatch and left provider requests and canonical mutations at zero.

correction.action: Rebind the controller to the exact git rev-parse HEAD result and preserve the rejected preparation as workflow cost.
correction.prevention_control: Inject full Git objects directly from the resolver into schema-backed builders; reports and packets may display only a machine-returned value and never a manually expanded abbreviation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the rejected hand-entered full Git object and extends the machine-injected object-ID control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A sparse worker packet must contain the complete resolved file dependency closure of every command admitted in its manifest before dispatch.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first sparse worker packet omitted one base focused test named by the admitted command manifest.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Controller prepare compared the packet contents with the manifest before dispatch, rejected the incomplete packet and made no provider request or canonical mutation.

correction.action: Add the exact missing dependency, rerun controller prepare and admit only the complete sparse packet.
correction.prevention_control: Generate sparse worktree inclusion from the manifest's mechanically resolved dependency graph rather than maintaining a second hand-authored file list.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the predispatch sparse dependency omission and the manifest-derived closure control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The accepted rc.7 composition must mount the exact emr4-bounded-worker preset, expose only edit, glob and read and reach the provider boundary before a useful occupied worker can begin.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The sole worker reached broker and HMR readiness but terminated at EFFECTIVE_TOOL_COMPOSITION_PRESET_MOUNT_FAILED before any DeepSeek request, model step, tool call, test or edit.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Runner, HMR and broker terminals recorded the collapsed failure coordinate, unchanged owned placeholder hashes, zero provider-boundary counts and exact cleanup.

correction.action: Consume the worker without retry, preserve its terminal and complete the exact frozen adapter/test package under Sol ownership.
correction.prevention_control: Before another occupied worker, run the identical agents.create full-profile mount provider-disabled, split safe preset-mount coordinates and compare model-owned paths by baseline and terminal hashes.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the pre-provider native preset-mount failure as Harness—not DeepSeek-quality—evidence and requires a provider-disabled identical mount smoke.

agent_error_observations.detection_method: The first deterministic runner failed that exact historical assertion before candidate commit; Sol preserved the rejected receipt and changed no implementation or authority source.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected deterministic receipt and remove only the immutable-history source-pin test from the descendant command manifest.
correction.prevention_control: Select descendant tests from machine-readable compatibility metadata that distinguishes invariant coverage from predecessor-byte pinning instead of using filename proximity.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected immutable source-pin test selection and the future compatibility-metadata selector.
